title: The Mechanic Prince
description: A humble mechanic hides a secret: he's heir to a fortune and a throne he walked away from. When his past catches up, two women around him are about to find out who he really is.
descriptionMore: To everyone on his street, he's just the mechanic who fixes their cars and carries their groceries home — quiet, hardworking, and happy to stay invisible. But behind the grease-stained overalls is a man who once walked away from a fortune, a title, and a family that never stopped looking for him. When his old life finally catches up, two women are pulled into the fallout: one who fell for the mechanic without knowing what he was giving up, and one who arrives determined to drag him back to the throne he refuses to claim. As old loyalties clash with new feelings, he has to decide whether the crown is worth losing the life — and the people — he's built for himself.
